cards.title: PPT Distillable Entanglement Proven Strictly Below Regularised Rains Bound
cards.why_it_matters: If you track quantum information theory or quantum ML foundations, this resolves a 2019 open problem about entanglement manipulation limits under PPT channels—a key constraint in quantum Shannon theory.
cards.summary: New results characterise PPT distillable entanglement in the asymptotic vanishing-error regime: (a) a regularised formula via a measured-relative-entropy-like quantity, and (b) two single-letter upper bounds. Crucially, (b) proves PPT distillable entanglement can be strictly below the regularised Rains bound—demonstrated concretely for 3×3 Werner states at antisymmetric weight 25/26, where a certified upper bound of 0.62107 ebits falls below the Rains bound of ~0.64766 ebits.
